'''Solitary and Menacing!''' (Japanese: '''孤高の闘士サイトウ！オトスパスの脅威！！''' ''The Solitary Fighter {{tt|Saitou|Bea}}! The Threatening {{tt|Otosupus|Grapploct}}!!'') is the eleventh chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the [[JN034|animated series episode by the same name]].

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{Ash}} is revealed to have {{pkmn2|caught}} a {{rf|Galarian}} {{AP|Farfetch'd}}.
* {{Ash}} faces [[Bea]] in a [[World Coronation Series]] match and loses.

===Debuts===
====Humans====

* {{p|Hawlucha}}

==Differences between the animated series and the manga==

* As the second half of ''[[JN027|Toughing It Out!]]'' was skipped, [[Ash's Farfetch'd]] debuts here.
